info.title: Logistics API
info.description: A minimal example of a monetized API gateway built on Zuplo's Monetization feature. Three plans (bronze, silver, gold), each with its own gateway rate limit. The gold plan bundles two APIs (Shipping + Delivery); bronze and silver each get exactly one, enforced via requiredEntitlements on the monetization policy.

tags.name: Shipping
tags.description: Shipments and their carrier, route and status.

tags.name: Delivery
tags.description: Delivery status and proof of delivery.

get.description: Shipping API. Requires the 'shipping_requests' entitlement (included in the bronze and gold plans).
Delivery API. Requires the 'delivery_requests' entitlement (included in the silver and gold plans).
